title: Opening, nickname Showboy, birthplace and birth date
summary: Russell opens the interview; Thomas gives his name, explains the Showboy nickname from his show drumming, and says he was born in Napoleonville in 1907.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: I'll start off with saying this is Bill Russell speaking. We're having an interview with Mr. Worthy Thomas up at his home at 2316 Washington and the date is December 11th, 1961. Do you mind giving your full name and tell how you got your nickname of showboy too? Well my full name is

Worthy G Thomas. That G stands for George. Worthy of George Thomas and I got the name of showboy. Back in the 20s I was a good show drummer. I played drum 17 years. Were you traveling in those days? I was traveling different carnival shows and by being a good show drummer everybody started
calling me showboy. Do you mind telling me just where you were born and what part of the town if it

was here? I don't even know for sure. I was born in Napoleonville, Louisiana. That's about 69 miles from here. Yes up the river. That's on Baila Fush and been in this town 41 years. What is your age if

you don't mind telling us? Age 54. And what day is your birthday? Born 1907, 26 of February. 26? Really? That's my birthday. 26? Well that's a coincidence. Sorry, it doesn't matter if there's any noise around. Did your father or anybody in the family play music? Any brothers and sisters or uncles or your mother? Did she play anything about your family?
